clinical_boundary.exception_clause: If the subject explicitly used a term, it may exist only in raw source text or subject_words, not as system inference, normalized tag, Gumi label, or policy output.

conditions: subject scope matches current Hermes profile
no pause is active for the marker scope
no recent burden signal blocks recall
the marker was subject-confirmed or subject-authored
recall_rule.note: Hindsight is not authority. Direct recall from Hindsight to user is forbidden.

safe_flow: only confirmed marker enters Shared Continuity Memory
forbidden_flow: Gumi directly follows up on sensitive content

design_principle: Relational continuity first. Structured tracking second.
